title: Utilization changes the cost per useful job
method: Synthetic annual allocated cost of $720,000 divided by twelve million or eight million qualifying jobs. Cloud rate is an explicit hypothetical assumption. Currency, service scope, recovery coverage and accounting period must match for comparison.
alt: Utilization changes the cost per useful job: Owned at 12m jobs 0.06 USD per job, Owned at 8m jobs 0.09 USD per job, Illustrative cloud option 0.075 USD per job. Illustrative inputs.
